theme: A whimsical and nostalgic fairytale setting with a regal yet secluded atmosphere, set in a lush royal garden dominated by a majestic linden tree. The imagery should exude an air of mystique and old-world charm, featuring gentle autumn winds and a blend of whimsy and gentle tension. Artistic elements should include a soft, painterly style with muted earth tones and subtle highlights to capture the vintage essence of folklore. Characters portrayed with a touch of innocence and curiosity, embodying traditional Scandinavian attire and courtly elegance.
